registers.finding: Same 12 IDs, same 12 URLs, different field names. Only citation-register.json is read by the builder.

Prints a rate beside each product although Table 1 is category-level and no SKU attribution is confirmed (FLG-07).
Guide pages print 'Observed in an Amazon redirect check on 2026-11-20' from a constant, while the targets were re-confirmed on 2026-11-21.
Two different cadences were published ('every two weeks' and 'monthly'). The 23:32 UTC merge of PR #29 removed the two-week sentence.
